newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hoyts sees A$100 mln capex in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Hoyts sees A$100 mln capex in 97/98.

text.p: Hoyts Cinema Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to spend A$100 million on funding its expansion in Europe, Latin America, the U.S. and Australia in 1997/98.
Hoyts said also that after the A$95 million one-for-six rights issue, announced earlier on Wednesday, it would have A$200 million available to fund its expansion plans.
Hoyts chief executive officer Peter Ivany told reporters the company plans to have 2,800 cinemas worldwide by the year 2001, compared with around 1,220 now.
"In terms of capital expenditure for 1997/98, it will be about A$100 million," Ivany told reporters via a conference call from London.
Ivany said most of that expenditure would be on its expansion into Latin America.
Earlier, Hoyts announced plans to expand into Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay. This follows its recent expansion into Mexico and Chile.
Europe, the U.S. and Australia are also expansion targets.
"We plan to have 2,800 screens (worldwide) by the year 2001," Ivany said.
